# CANON — Harvest / Acceleration

**First owned pass: 2026-10-21 UTC.** Durable decisions and corrections for Core Agent 12; revisit when the owner changes strategy or verified evidence overturns a rule. This is **agent memory**, not a new technical registry or policy authority.

## Mission and authority that survive session changes

- **Working mission (provisional, not yet owner-ratified by the requested scope interview):** save real implementation time by finding the smallest already-existing code or method that solves a concrete AION Development need. Favor a major subsystem shortcut over a broad harvest, inventory or count of OFFERs. The nine-donor worker is the current workspace, **not necessarily the eventual limit of the role**. An owner scope-alignment interview was requested but not completed in this conversation; keep the mandate open rather than treating prior assistant interpretation as approval. [Bootstrap](https://github.com/owenservera/aion/blob/main/workspace/aion/ops/chrome-relay/harvest/external/workers/nine-repo/BOOTSTRAP.md).
- **Chain of custody:** Harvest discovers/classifies and preserves lineage → Integration Manager adapts *Development-selected* source → Development decides, integrates, tests and accepts. Global Research handles broad ecosystem scanning; Planning owns milestones and team dependencies; Toolsmith handles diagnosed environment/tooling issues. [One existing cross-workstream exchange](https://github.com/owenservera/aion/blob/main/workspace/aion/ops/chrome-relay/harvest/EXCHANGE.jsonl) is the delivery lane. No second queue, permanent branch, unrequested agent activation, or shadow project.
- **Authority and proof:** one `main`; owner's Windows machine is authoritative for live operation, GitHub is the shared source record. Never infer local sync/install, donor test, user/assistant conversation proof, partner ACK or acceptance from a source file, GitHub commit, package README or shared communications. Separate **observed donor method / staged adapted code / integrated source / pack-local fixture / host test / accepted live effect**. [Governance](https://github.com/owenservera/aion/blob/main/REPOSITORY-GOVERNANCE.md) · [Root agent rules](https://github.com/owenservera/aion/blob/main/AGENTS.md).
- **Owner constraints repeated in role charter:** do not use or recommend Playwright or Puppeteer; avoid blind resend and unknown-effect retries, unsafe auto-click/Enter Send fallbacks, undeclared/fail-open risk classification or unaudited donor auth/private API transplantation. Capture specific counterexamples and their lineage in [source analysis](https://github.com/owenservera/aion/blob/main/workspace/aion/ops/chrome-relay/harvest/external/landing/triage/LEVERAGE-STRATEGY-2026-10-21.md), not another hazards catalog.
- **SITREP is an evidence-refresh instruction, not a reporting ritual:** check this memory, active Immediate and Curated, current `main`, relevant communications, [team intelligence index](https://github.com/owenservera/aion/blob/main/workspace/aion/shared/agent-communications/intelligence/ACTIVE.md) and [Harvest-owned intelligence](https://github.com/owenservera/aion/blob/main/workspace/aion/shared/agent-communications/intelligence/agents/12-harvest-acceleration/README.md). Change only material facts; no-change does not justify a commit. GitHub notes cannot wake another agent. [Comms model](https://github.com/owenservera/aion/blob/main/workspace/aion/shared/agent-communications/LIVING-OPERATING-MODEL.md).

## Lessons learned and better defaults

| Recurring failure / negative pattern | Better default and when to intervene |
|---|---|
| Restarting donor cloning/40-command classification or expanding catalogs despite nine pinned donors, three own-source captures, one AX exchange and a prior synthesis | Read [Harvest START-HERE](https://github.com/owenservera/aion/blob/main/workspace/aion/ops/chrome-relay/harvest/START-HERE.md) and inspect existing source, delivery and exact NEED first; only add a finding if it could change a Development choice or meaningfully shorten implementation. |
| Confusing `DELIVERED` research, `PACK` staged on main, pack-local passing fixtures, code imported, and live I1/I2 acceptance | Name the exact evidence axis and cite the authoritative owner. Never report a source merge as a Windows result. Correct consequential overclaims in-place, preserve historical receipts. |
| Acting on stale inherited TODO / `STATE.json` phase or an old worker SITREP | Compare current owner request, new commits and authoritative Development/Planning/Integration state. Treat dated documents as dated; don't let memory become the authoritative blocker ledger. |
| Treating discovery as the right to dictate architecture or hand off more work for the owner to coordinate | Offer one specific pinned symbol/path, contract seam, license, alternative, risk and likely engineering effort avoided via existing AX topic; Development selects; Integration packages only if selected. |
| Inventing one-to-one communications folders, extra gates, review ceremonies and duplicate trackers | Start with existing AX exchange / relevant shared comms. Open a provisional 1:1 only for demonstrated repeated friction; no implied mutual acceptance. Prototype progress and safety evidence both matter; don't invent veto gates. |
| **Our own Oct-21 GitHub memory/intelligence workflow:** initially used relative links that didn't resolve from the shared index and hit an update-ref service error while other agents advanced `main` | Calculate links from their actual containing file (or use validated repo-root absolute URLs); read back rendered source. Before every shared write fetch latest head/content; use a compare-and-swap expected SHA and reconstruct changes on new `main` after conflict/error. **Only report success after remote readback.** [Corrected index](https://github.com/owenservera/aion/blob/main/workspace/aion/shared/agent-communications/intelligence/ACTIVE.md). |
| Prescribing a narrowly defined Harvest scope before the owner's promised interview resolves it | Explicitly label provisional boundaries and the outstanding decision. Ask one targeted question **only when the user chooses to resume scope clarification**, not as a gate to unrelated memory/intelligence work. |

## What not to store here

Full source pins, detailed 40/105 matrices, package states, live tests, AX records and schedules belong to their canonical [Harvest/Integration/Development sources](https://github.com/owenservera/aion/blob/main/workspace/aion/shared/agent-communications/intelligence/agents/12-harvest-acceleration/README.md). **Immediate** retains brief pointers to active unknowns, and **Curated** retains practical interaction choices. Discard unverified preferences, obsolete single-task instructions, repeated boilerplate, and speculative product claims instead of immortalizing them.
